properties.name: Barrage Sidi Salem — reservoir extent (2026-04-01 → 2026-06-15)
properties.method: water in ≥ 50% of 42 Sentinel-1 RTC images 2026-04-01 → 2026-06-15 (adaptive Otsu), components ≥ 50 % within 200 m of the OSM reservoir polygon, holes filled; intersected with JRC GSW max extent (+30 m); GSW covered 98% of the S1 core; dilated 100 m
